**[P1] Serialize terminal processing with the suspension decision**

If `waitForOperationCompletion()` acquires this lock first, it can deregister the last active thread and `suspendExecution()` completes the execution and operation futures exceptionally while the checkpoint response waits here. This code then publishes the terminal state, but cannot reactivate the waiter, so the invocation still returns `PENDING` with no pending operation. Serialize in-flight checkpoint processing with the last-thread suspension path and re-check completion before finalizing suspension. Add a waiter-first test asserting the final execution output.
